lines.text: You can vibe code your own app now. But three things scare people off — security, hosting, and GitHub. Here's the thing: none of them are that scary.
A static HTML file on a host? Pretty safe. The more your app does, the more you think about — but you start simple, you start safe.
Push your code to GitHub — point Railway at the repo — and it deploys on every push. Walk away.
GitHub is just where your code lives — so the host can grab it. The AI handles the git commands. You don't need to be a wizard.
Now level up. Add a database, real login, row level security — each person only sees their own data. Layer by layer, still not scary.
Then the fun part — wire up your own agent. Zapier's SDK handles the plumbing. A task on your phone shows up in your app. Your agent, your systems.
Pick one idea. Open your AI tool. Ask for a hello world. That's vibe coding with confidence.
